answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow unlock stops fakes. Each agent seals a 30-unit bond that unlocks only when its work shows a fingerprint — timing, task mix, error pattern — like yarrow growing a unique root shape. Identical copies fail and their onyx-hard bond freezes 5 epochs. Running 100 fakes locks 3,000 units and burns 100 compute units per epoch against a 30-unit reward, so forgery loses. One honest agent pays once and keeps its reef place.
